reply.text:
I'm sorry to hear about your shins. Sore shins are one for a doctor or physio to look at, not a coach, so I won't assess what's going on there. Please get it checked before you run on them again.

On the swap itself: I can't make that change by talking to you, but I can send it through as a program edit for tomorrow's run. Tell me whether you want the run moved to the elliptical or dropped, and I'll set it up for you to confirm in the app. Once a doctor or physio has cleared you, I'll help you build the running back in around whatever they say.
